title: We Found Out!
desc: Two little lines that changed everything — the moment we found out you were on your way.
story: It was the 2nd of June 2025, and nothing about that morning felt any different to usual. Until it was. We stared at that little test together, and there they were. Two lines. Clear as anything. For a moment neither of us said a word. Then it hit us, all at once, that there was a tiny life beginning and it was ours. There were tears, there was laughter, and there were probably a few shaky hands too. We had absolutely no idea what was coming, but we already knew it was going to be the greatest adventure of our lives.
